_comment: Curated data.gov.in resource IDs used to source the project's raw data.
_how_to_find_ids: Log in at https://data.gov.in, open a dataset page, click 'API' and copy the resource UUID from the URL (https://api.data.gov.in/resource/<UUID>). Or run: python scripts/fetch_datagovin.py --search <keyword>.
_api_key: Set DATAGOVIN_API_KEY env var or put your key in config/api_key.txt (free registration at data.gov.in).
